none: PAS NCL-080F21: NCL-080F21: A copper-alloy stud from a Roman cavalry helmet of the late 2nd/3rd century.
contea di ritrovamento: Northumberland (Inghilterra e Galles)

A ferrous copper-alloy conical study from a Roman helmet, dating to the late 2nd and 3rd centuries. The main body of the stud bears an inscribed line around its circumference 3.48mm from the base.
